name: htmlandhtml-com
description: HTML&HTML bilingual evidence-first website validator with 12 scan engines, formal llms.txt v2 verification and paid implementation mandates

scripts.test: npm run test:integrity && npm run test:client
scripts.test:client: node --check assets/js/validator.js && node --check assets/js/docs.js && node --check scripts/standards-watch.mjs
scripts.firebase:build: npm --prefix firebase-functions install --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund && npm --prefix firebase-functions run build
scripts.firebase:serve: npm run firebase:build && npx -y firebase-tools@latest emulators:start --only hosting,functions
scripts.firebase:deploy: npm run firebase:build && npx -y firebase-tools@latest deploy --only functions,hosting
